item.title: Scenic AVL #7: Scott Mountain — Tue Aug 11, 6:00 PM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group The weather looks like it will be okay tomorrow. Yeah!
There is very limited parking at the [trailhead](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fETct2fiMiLz1HEG8). Please plan to meet at Lake Hills Church parking lot at 10 minutes before the start to condense cars. Lake Hills Church Parking Lot is pictured above. - [https://maps.app.goo.gl/X1TctrhYv3gihmh66](https://maps.app.goo.gl/X1TctrhYv3gihmh66) *Call the hike leader at 828-290-0886 if you cannot find us. Do not text.
**Rating**: Moderate **Elevation**: 800 **Distance**: 5 miles **Surface**: Trail **Pace**: 3 mph **Dogs**: on leash. **Gear**: Long pants recommended, bug spray, water. The ticks are bad on this trail. Bring your bug spray ! **Features**: wooded trail, interesting plants and fungi. Bears are shy, but we may see them, also deer and squirrels. 3 miles uphill, 2.25 down. **All Trails Route**: [Scott Mountain Loop on AllTrails](https://www.alltrails.com/explore/map/scott-mountain-loop-4217403?p=-1&sh=ifwm3x)

item.title: Free Jazz Tuesday w/ The Will Boyd Project — Tue Aug 11, 7:00 PM — Little Jumbo
item.description: The Will Boyd Project isn’t just a band—it’s a spiritual reckoning delivered through reeds and rhythm, a sonic revival where the sacred traditions of the Black church collide with the revolutionary fire of jazz. Led by multi-instrumentalist and “mad sax man” Will Boyd, this ensemble transforms every performance into a joyful noise that honors the soul sax prophets—Eddie Harris, Hank Crawford, King Curtis—while pushing the movement forward with urgent, right-now energy. Come out to Little Jumbo this Tuesday to hear the Will Boyd Project featuring Bill Bares (keys), Zack Page (bass), Alan Hall (drums), and Will Boyd on various reed instruments. No cover. See you there! Every Monday and Tuesday, Little Jumbo brings live jazz to your ears. littlejumbobar.com “Simply put, Little Jumbo should be at the top of your list of places for cocktails in Asheville. item.title: Ask About Our Featured Listings — Wed Aug 12 — LiveMusicAsheville.com
item.description:
Established in February 2019, LiveMusicAsheville.com now reaches thousands of people every week actively searching for live music in the Asheville area. Roughly 60% of our traffic comes from Google Search as we dominate the top of the results for queries such as “Asheville live music” & “live music Asheville”. Meanwhile our direct traffic is experiencing explosive growth, proving more locals are now using us as their go-to music calendar. Our free listings include just the basics of Who’s Playin’ Where & When. Our Featured Listings really stand out among the dozens of events on the calendar every day. While we update every Wednesday for the following Friday thru Thursday, these Featured Listings are published much sooner and include your picture or poster, a description of the event and the venue, website/ticket links and a Google map. We also share these events on our social media stories to help further promote your show.
Source: LiveMusicAsheville.com

item.title: Guided Masterclass: AI As Your Thinking Partner — Tue Aug 18, 12:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads **A live session on using AI to sharpen judgment, prep for hard moments, and communicate with real clarity, not just work faster.**
Everyone's using AI to move faster. Almost no one's asking if it's making them sharper.
That's the gap this Guided Masterclass steps into. Join Shellie Sullivan (Chief Growth Officer, [Abby AI](https://www.abby-ai.com/)) and Jason Alexander (Founder, [ChiefAI](https://chiefai.co/)) for a live, moderated conversation hosted by Ric Pratte on using AI as a genuine thinking partner, not just a task-doer.
This isn't a tools rundown. It's a working session in three parts:
* **Sharper judgment**, using AI to pressure-test decisions and surface blind spots before you commit; * **Better preparation**, rehearsing hard conversations and stress-testing plans before they matter; and * **Clearer communication**, saying what you actually mean across async, cross-timezone teams where tone carries more weight than it should have to.

Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
A note about the format We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.

**Sundays 8/16-9/13, 10:30am-11:45am** Whether it’s everyday stress, sadness, or even anger, our suffering can be transformed into inner strength, love, and joy. The first step is understanding its source. In this series, we’ll explore Buddha’s teachings on the Four Noble Truths. The Four Noble Truths are the essence of Buddhist thought and gives us a clear, precise way to understand our life and how to move forward in it. Through teachings and meditation, we’ll discover that suffering comes not from external conditions, but from our own mind. Recognizing this opens the door to transforming our experience and uncovering a more lasting, genuine happiness.
